0022600167.text: The Celtics (5-1) visit the Rockets (6-1) in Boston's seventh game of the season, with Boston second in the Atlantic and third in the East, and Houston second in the Southwest and second in the West, both 0.5 games back in their divisions. Boston enters on a five-game winning streak and is 1-1 on the road, while Houston is 3-0 at home and has won its last game, and the teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1 before Boston won the most recent meeting 114-93 in Houston on February 4, 2026. Devin Carter is out for Boston with illness and Mitchell Robinson is day-to-day with rest and a game-time decision, while Houston is without Steven Adams (out, calf strain) and has Clint Capela (ankle sprain) and Reed Sheppard (back) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions.
